svg.metadata: {"story":"Gideon","act":6,"chapter":"Ch.6 · The Battle","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"The three hundred shatter jars, light torches, blow trumpets, and shout for the Lord and for Gideon; the host turns on itself.
